name: docloom
description: Closed-loop documentation quality pipeline — init, register, brainstorm, build-spec, author, review, fix, and entropy analysis for continuous spec improvement.

interface.shortDescription: Structured doc pipeline: brainstorm → spec → author → review → fix → entropy.
interface.longDescription: End-to-end documentation quality system: project initialization and document type registration → collaborative brainstorming with interactive approval → type-specific spec generation → structured authoring with embedded schemas → automated review against spec-derived checklists → context-mode fix consumption with brainstorm-assisted refinement → entropy analysis of fix patterns driving continuous spec evolution.
defaultPrompt: Review this document against its spec
Generate a feedback note for this PRD
Analyze fix patterns and suggest spec improvements
